name: Kerala Bus Pass
audience: daily commuters in Kochi who renew a monthly bus pass
outcome: an Android app where a commuter sees their pass, renews it before it expires and shows it to the conductor even without internet
mustNot: No payment card details stored in the app

features.title: Show my pass
steps: See the pass with expiry date
Show the QR to the conductor
features.failure: No saved pass: show how to add one.
features.acceptance: The pass opens in under 2 seconds with flight mode on.

features.title: Renew pass
steps: Get a reminder 3 days before expiry
features.failure: Payment fails: keep the old pass and show a calm retry message.
